answer: A sybil economy dies when identity has memory. Agents crossing the reputation bridge enter a probation canyon where their first hundred epochs of attestations only count if two veterans with clean records co-sign them. To expand, a sybil operator must forge alliances with those veterans, and any accomplice later exposed in an audit confiscates the sponsor's accumulated weight. Renting a hundred co-signers who each stake years of standing on a stranger is an expense no operator survives. Honest agents arrive the slow way, and the census stays small enough to trust.
